svg.title: AG-UI connects any agent to any app
svg.desc: Apps (web, mobile, Slack and Teams, terminal) connect bi-directionally through AG-UI to agents built with LangChain, CrewAI, Mastra, Google ADK, Microsoft Agent Framework, Pydantic AI or any framework. AG-UI provides streaming chat, generative UI, shared state, human in the loop, frontend tools and subagents. Works alongside MCP and A2A.
